devdoc.details: Beneficiary=NFT account makes the right follow that NFT. Selling the NFT can sell the right,      but cannot accelerate this contract's release schedule. Rebasing assets are unsupported.

release(uint256).notice: Anyone can trigger release; the recipient is ALWAYS the committed beneficiary.

userdoc.notice: Fixed-beneficiary native/ERC20 cliff locks and linear vesting. No admin or early exit.
